plugins.name: vitrinka
plugins.description: The vitrinka experience: capture UI work as journeys and walkthroughs, author documents, pages and diagrams, brainstorm on a decision board, and service a board's annotation queue. Registers nothing itself — `vitrinka setup` adds the MCP endpoint.

plugins.name: vitrinka-pm
plugins.description: The work loop on top of core: pick a task up, hand it back, file what you spot, drive the task engine and a project's release, keep personal todos and reminders. Ships the session hooks that stamp a run, cue a pickup and gate the hand-back.

plugins.name: vitrinka-qa
plugins.description: The testing pipeline on top of core: test like a user, process recorded sessions, pair with a human who is testing live, review a board's screens or a journey, and spot what you will not fix now.

plugins.name: vitrinka-experimental
plugins.description: Flows still proving themselves, beside core: build-idea takes a committed brief to a draft PR with one quick check, make-idea runs a brainstorm into it, test asks which lanes and device checks to run, cleanup reconciles a project's tasks against reality. Claude Code only; opt in with `vitrinka setup --experimental`.
